S.K. Putt’s Paralyze is a short, thrill ride of a cyberpunk novel that crackles with neon-soaked energy, punk rock and razor-sharp wit. In Paralyze, Putt asks: when your flesh is synthetic and your mind is enhanced, what part of you is still human?
